confirmed_root_cause.description: Actuator channel permutation: pulse commanded to 'VAV_1' actuated heating in 'VAV_2' (delta 0.900 K) while target 'VAV_1' remained unheated (delta 0.050 K).

patch_description: Added SemanticActuatorProbe.diagnose_channel_misalignment() to isolate swapped channel indices.

pre_repair_reproduction.description: Probe evaluation on swapped channels yielded binary failure without identifying culprit pair.
pre_repair_reproduction.observed_pre_repair: Binary failure, target delta 0.050 K < threshold 0.200 K
